news.description: The Busan KCC defended the pride of the KBL champion. KCC won 108-94 in the home opener against EASL Group B Houchon in the 2026-2027 season at Busan Jikuk Gymnasium on the 5th. KCC recorded two consecutive victories and took the lead in Group B alone. At the center of the victory were Sean Long, Lewis King, and Huong. Long had 34 points and 20 rebounds, and King had 34 points and 13 rebounds.
